hook: You can stand on ice you see through.
title: Your Feet On Ice You Can See Through
description:
Lake Baikal in Siberia freezes into ice so clear you can see cracks and bubbles deep below. It is the deepest lake on Earth and holds about 20% of the world's unfrozen fresh water. All of that sits right under your boots.

#Shorts #LakeBaikal #PlacesThatShouldntExist
comment_prompt: Would you walk on it? Yes or no
